votes.motion: Approve the request for a Voluntary Toll by the Lunenburg Boys & Girls Club on 6/14/2014 in the center of Town and at Electric Avenue & Whalom Road.
votes.quote: ms. bertram moved to approve the request for the voluntary toll by the lunenburg boys & girls club on 6/14/2014 in the center of town

votes.motion: Approve the request to transfer the Liquor License from RNDC, Inc. to KJ Waterfront, Inc., located at 84 Lakefront Avenue.
votes.quote: ms. bertram moved to approve the request to transfer the liquor license from rndc, inc. to kj waterfront, inc., located at 84 lakefront avenue. mr. toale seconded.

votes.motion: Continue the Public Hearing on the Fitchburg Gas & Electric (Unitil) pole location petition until 5/13/2014 at 7:15PM.
votes.quote: mr. ebersole moved to continue this public hearing until 5/13/2014, at 7:15pm, for further consideration at that time. ms. bertram seconded.

votes.motion: Appoint Dave Matthews to serve on the Building Reuse Committee as a Community at Large Member.
votes.quote: mr. toale moved that dave matthews be appointed by the bos to serve on the building reuse committee as a community at large member. ms. bertram seconded.
adjournment: being no further business ms. bertram moved to adjourn the meeting. mr. ebersole seconded.
